AGENDA ITEMS AND ACTIONS
5:00 P.M. CLOSED SESSION

CALL TO ORDER Mayor Lainez called the Closed Session meeting to order at 5:12 p.m.

ROLL CALL

PUBLIC COMMENT ON CLOSED SESSION ITEMS There were no individuals wishing to address the City Council on any Closed Session items.

RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION The members of the City Council and Successor Agency recessed to Closed Session at 5:13 p.m.

RECONVENE TO OPEN SESSION Four members present of the City Council and Successor Agency reconvened to open session at 6:35 p.m.

ORAL CLOSED SESSION ANNOUNCEMENT City Attorney Tapia reported that the City Council had convened in Closed Session. All five members of the City Council participated in Closed Session. Council Member Ivan Altamirano participated remotely pursuant to the just-cause provisions applicable to remote participation.

Regarding Closed Session Item No. 1 Closed Session Items A through D City staff made presentations, and the City Council provided direction. No final reportable action was taken.

ADJOURNMENT There being no further business, Mayor Kevin Lainez adjourned the meeting at 8:26 p.m. in memory of Sandra “Sandy” Cornejo and Renee Lara.

Written materials distributed to the City Council are available for public inspection immediately following the posting of this agenda (at least 72 hours prior to a regular City Council meetings) in the City Clerk's Office, at Commerce City Hall, 2535 Commerce Way, Commerce, California, and the Central Library, 5655 Jillson Street, Commerce, California.

Meeting facilities are accessible to persons with disabilities. ln compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, notify the Office of the City Clerk at (323) 722-4805 at least 24 hours prior to the meeting.

Pursuant to Government Code §54957.6 the City Council will confer with its labor negotiator, Ernie Hernandez, with respect to labor negotiations pertaining to:

A. The Memoranda of Understanding between the City and the City of Commerce Employees Association on behalf of the part -time employees.

B. The Memoranda of Understanding between the City and the City of Commerce Employees Association on behalf of the mid-management and non-management fulltime employees.

C. The Memoranda of Understanding between the City and Transportation Department Employees Association on behalf of the transportation employees.

D. The Memoranda of Understanding between the City and the Unrepresented Executive Management employees.
